entities.label: Mangrove/cypress tree with prop roots or stilt trunks
entities.looks_like: Trunk with vertical root stilts, knees, or branching lower supports in murky water — not generic round oak

entities.label: Hanging moss or vine drape from swamp trees
entities.looks_like: Vertical green/grey strands or thin boxes hanging from branches over water

entities.label: Lily pads — flat green discs on swamp water
entities.looks_like: Flat wide thin green boxes at water surface height on swamp pools

entities.label: Sugar cane or reed stalks on swamp shores
entities.looks_like: Tall thin vertical green/tan stalks at water edges

entities.label: Murky standing pool — dark green/brown still water
entities.looks_like: Dark olive/brown water color or voxels, not bright cyan flowing river

entities.label: Olive/grey swamp water tint — not ocean turquoise
entities.looks_like: Water material or top-color in olive, grey-green, or brown, distinct from lagoon cyan

entities.label: Mud/silt banks at swamp water edges
entities.looks_like: Brown/dark tan shore cubes or top-color at pool margins

entities.label: Mud or silt floor under swamp water — not sand seabed
entities.looks_like: Dark mud/dirt blocks as swamp ground or pool bottom

entities.label: Low dense fog/mist hugging swamp water — swamp atmosphere
entities.looks_like: Large pale particles at low altitude over swamp with minimal drift, denser than highland mist

entities.label: Marsh animals (frog/fox) at waterline grounded on terrain
entities.looks_like: Small fauna voxels at swamp edge with y from terrain/water level

must_not_present.label: Bright turquoise coastal ocean as swamp water
Cactus or sandstorm in the swamp
Snow or blizzard in the swamp
